concurrency: 4 shards (by component_size), run concurrently as independent OS processes (<=5 concurrent instructed budget; machine shared with one other job observed running throughout, per `ps aux` during the run).

pilot_calibration.note: Runtime estimated from committed axis_robustness_p6 tiered-shard logs (2.24/3.36/4.53/6.94 s/instance at c=6/8/10/12), then calibrated with a live 12-instance pilot (component_size in {6,12}, n_tiers in {2,3,4}, 2 instances/cell) before committing to the full run.
pilot_calibration.decision: 40 instances/cell (480 total) fit easily within the 4-hour budget (observed ~11 min wall-clock for the full run at 4 concurrent shards); no reduction to 20/cell was needed.

design_summary: Tiered-arm instances only. Query (treatment) drawn uniformly at random among admissible candidates AFTER the component graph is built (component_size in {6,8,10,12}, n_tiers in {2,3,4}, 40 instances/cell, 480 total); separation is measured, never a targeted spec parameter. See src/bkrobust/robustness/unconfounded_generator.py module docstring for the exact admissibility rule and src/bkrobust/robustness/run_unconfounded_v2.py for the driver.
